description: Extract tables from a PDF ($0.01 USDC via x402). Pass pdf_base64 or a https pdf_url. Optional schema maps headers. Optional max_pages (1-10). Returns JSON { pages, tables: [{ page, headers, rows }], warnings }. Text PDFs are parsed in-worker; scans require HOSTED_PARSER_URL. Provided as is, with no warranty or guarantee of accuracy or fitness. Nothing is stored.

max_pages.description: Max pages to read. Capped at 10.

pdf_base64.description: Raw PDF encoded as base64 (optionally a data: URL). Provide this or pdf_url.

pdf_url.description: https URL of a PDF. Provide this or pdf_base64. Max 8 MB.

schema.description: Optional header mapping. Object maps extracted header -> output name; array replaces headers in column order.

name: extract-table-from-pdf
